description: This file defines a web scraper class 'RutgerBakt' for extracting recipe information from the website 'rutgerbakt.nl'. It includes methods for retrieving the author, title, category, ingredients, instructions, and description of recipes, utilizing HTML parsing and utility functions.

classes.name: RutgerBakt
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from rutgerbakt.nl, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the recipe title.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe category from the page.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns None as yields are not parsed.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients using a utility function.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions by locating the relevant heading and parsing subsequent elements.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the first paragraph as the recipe description.
